ns2:course.label: Biostatistics in Public Health
ns2:course.description: Introduction to fundamental topics in biostatistics in public health, covering univariate and bivariate statistics as well as basic topics in multivariate analysis. Including practice in analyzing health data through computer laboratory sessions.
ns2:course.sectionRegistrationNotes: Not intended for Public Health (MPH) major(s). Restricted to Graduate - Urbana-Champaign.
ns2:course.classScheduleInformation: Enrollment in the MPH program or consent of the instructor is required.
